topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 21 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 16 common project-authored base contract(s) (baseupgradeabilityproxy, proxy, accesscontrolenumerable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
